data.name: Hotelera Diego de Almagro
data.address: Ejército 516, 5501882 Puerto Montt, Los Lagos, Chile
data.description:
Set a 1-minute walk from the nearest bus stop, this unassuming hotel is also 3 km from Museo Municipal Juan Pablo II, a museum of cultural history, and 20 km from Alerce Andino National Park.
The straightforward rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and en suite bathrooms. All also provide minibars, room service and desks.
The hotel offers a free breakfast buffet in an airy restaurant, which serves a menu of Llanquihue fare. There's a heated pool, a sauna and a fitness center, as well as a game room with pool and table tennis tables. Other amenities include a business center and meeting space, plus guest laundry and a parking garage.
